title: DriverRequest
description: A person asking to become a car's current driver, usually by scanning the code on the car, and the answer. Held in the vehicle's eVault, so it stays with the car's history. For a private car the current driver answers. For a company car a member of the company becomes the driver at once, and the record is the log of who took the car and when.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the vehicle whose eVault holds this record

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle the requester wants to drive

requesterEName.description: eName of the person who wants to drive

askedEName.description: eName of the person who answers: the current driver, or the owner if the car has none. Absent when the request needed no answer.

companyEName.description: The company the requester belongs to, when this was a company car taken without asking

status.description: A pending request is treated as lapsed once expiresAt has passed

expiresAt.description: When a pending request lapses if nobody has answered it

decidedByEName.description: eName of the person who approved or declined the request

decidedAt.description: When the request was approved, declined or cancelled

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
